name: Mise
tagline: Recipe box, weekly meal planner and smart grocery list
description: For home cooks who plan the week's meals and shop once. It turns recipes into a combined grocery list by aisle, minus what is already in the pantry.
scope: Weekly planner with drag and drop
Grocery list that combines units and subtracts pantry
features: Paste free-text ingredient lines such as "1 1/2 cups flour" and get quantity, unit, name, notes and aisle
Serving scaler with cook-friendly fractions: 1/4 cup halved reads as 2 tbsp
Drag recipes onto a breakfast, lunch and dinner grid with pointer events, or tap + to add
Grocery list adds compatible units (2 tbsp + 1/4 cup = 6 tbsp), subtracts pantry stock and prints by aisle
Cook mode offers timers for the times mentioned in each step
Daily and weekly nutrition totals, with JSON export and import
engineering: A hand-written ingredient parser feeds a unit engine that adds amounts in base units and then picks the measure a cook would use, so 18 teaspoons of olive oil shows as 6 tbsp.
